Subject: Intro + scheduling a demo for Redwood Inference

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the quick intro call last week. Our product team is excited to see Redwood in action — we'd like to set up a live demo next week if possible.

A couple of constraints from our side: procurement/security have a gating process for all AI vendor demos that includes an NDA and a brief vendor security questionnaire. I don’t have the exact questionnaire yet but procurement has flagged it as required before a live walkthrough with engineers.

Are you able to: 1) run an initial demo with just product folks, or 2) hold a tentative window while we complete procurement intake? We’re flexible on times but would prefer late-morning PT.

Cheers,
Samir

Hi Samir — great to hear and thanks for the heads up on procurement gating.

We can do either: a concise product-level demo (30–40m) without deep infra Q&A, or a full technical walkthrough that typically requires procurement/security prerequisites. If procurement needs the questionnaire completed first, we can pause the live engineering demo and instead send an on-demand recording + a short Q&A with an engineer.

I attached our vendor security brief and a standard NDA link below to speed things up. Can you loop in your procurement/security contact (CC’d is helpful) so we can see the expected items and timeline? If procurement gives us clearance, our suggested live windows (PT):
- Tue 2029-07-16 10:00–11:00
- Wed 2029-07-17 11:00–12:00
- Thu 2029-07-18 09:30–10:30

If those don’t work, we’ll keep a tentative hold and propose a fallback the week of Jul 22.

Thanks — I’ll stand by and coordinate once procurement confirms.

Best,

Hi Tessa and Samir,

Thanks — per our vendor intake policy we need the following before we allow a live engineering demo with access to any sample data or infra details:
1) Signed NDA (DocuSign)
2) Completed vendor security questionnaire (see attached)
3) SOC 2 report or third-party attestation (recent)
4) Brief description of data residency and retention; any PHI handling must be flagged
5) Contact for technical escalation and point of contact for audits

Timeline: if we receive the signed NDA and questionnaire by COB Fri, 2029-07-19, we can aim to clear for a demo during the week of Jul 22. If not, the earliest clearance would likely be the week of Jul 29.

Anna Li (CC) will coordinate the questionnaire review. Please confirm if Redwood can provide a redacted SOC 2 or equivalent and whether you can complete the questionnaire in the requested window.

Regards,
Procurement Team — MediSphere Health
procurement@medisphere.com

Looping in quickly — thanks for the thread. A couple pragmatic options:

1) Put a tentative hold for the week of Jul 22 (no meeting content) so Samir’s team has a dedicated slot while procurement completes review. I attached a proposed calendar hold.
2) Send a 12–15 minute product walkthrough recording today and offer a 30m async office hour with an engineer to answer specific procurement/security questions. That keeps momentum without exposing infra details before intake is complete.

If procurement confirms clearance earlier (by Jul 19), we can flip the tentative hold into the live slot. If not, push to Jul 29–Aug 2.

Tessa — can you send the hold and the recording link to Samir and Anna? I’ll prepare a short FAQ for procurement referencing SOC 2 scope and redaction examples.
